chosen_args.why_stop: Stopping rule satisfied: S1 feasible optimized winner exists; S2 no unresolved candidate remains under optimization plus declared activity/price screening; S3 highest-activity candidate parity and reachability are complete and unreachable. Further affordable actions have low expected decision value for the deterministic canonical industrial decision.

unresolved_decision_risk.deterministic_model_risk: Low within the declared model/domain. candidate_13 has a 6.739 USD/t advantage over candidate_04 and all other non-optimized candidates are screened dominated by lower activity and higher price.
